content.comment_body: Hello, [company_name] team, This is [user_name]. I have purchased a [product_name] with Order Number: [article_no], and its Serial Number is [article_no]. Can you help confirm if the product is genuine or counterfeit? I have attached a picture for your reference. Best regards, [user_name].

Why are you questioning this? Is there an issue with the seller, or is there a lack of trust? Other users can't reliably determine the authenticity of your product. For accurate information, please contact [company_name] support and submit a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: A user has concerns about the authenticity of a newly acquired [product_name], sharing order and serial details and seeking verification. The conversation highlights that community members are unable to confirm product originality and recommends contacting official support channels for verification. Peer-to-peer forums are not equipped for such validation.
analysis.user_expectations: User is looking for an easy way to check the authenticity of a [company_name] [product_name], hoping for assistance either from the community or official support.
